<bos><|turn>user
You have tools read_file(path) and edit_file(path, patch). The function below has duplicated validation logic in three branches. Plan a refactor that removes the duplication without changing behavior, then emit the edit. Function: def handle(req):
  if req.kind=='a':
    if not req.user: raise Error('no user')
    if req.amount<=0: raise Error('bad amount')
    return do_a(req)
  if req.kind=='b':
    if not req.user: raise Error('no user')
    if req.amount<=0: raise Error('bad amount')
    return do_b(req)
  if req.kind=='c':
    if not req.user: raise Error('no user')
    if req.amount<=0: raise Error('bad amount')
    return do_c(req)<turn|>
